name: Kodak Kodachrome 200
source: Eastman Kodak, KODACHROME 25, 64, and 200 Professional Film, publication E-55 (2009-06), page 5

notes.characteristic: Daylight exposure 1/100 s with a 0.20 ND filter, process K-14, Status A densitometry.
notes.sensitivity: Effective exposure 1.4 s, K-14, E.N.D. density 1.00, sensitivity = 1/exposure (erg/cm2).
notes.dye_density: Dyes normalized to form a visual density of 1.0 for a viewing illuminant of 3200 K.

grain.note: Diffuse rms granularity, read at gross diffuse visual density 1.0, 48 µm aperture, 12X.
